title: Prove integral synthetic-transform identities and invertibility
body:
## Summary

Extend the retained synthetic transform's integral scaled-inverse identity to every commutative coefficient ring, with an explicit all-size coefficient-path proof and a sharp invertibility boundary.

```text
U_- = L B W_-       U_+ = W_+ B^-1 L^-1
U_+ U_- = U_- U_+ = M I
U_± invertible iff 2 is a unit
 det(U_±) = signed monomial unit * 2^(M log2(M)/2)
```

The proof also gives the exact-K named-slot formula for every finite mixed long/short shape. Normalized composition is I/M when 2 is invertible. A residue kernel prevents promoting the integral identity to an inverse when 2 is not a unit.

The frozen source already proves the complex identities. This independently corroborates that algebra beyond the earlier finite-only layout audit and adds the integral ring/invertibility statement. It reports no source defect, new algorithm, supplier, or improved kappa. All nine new files are isolated in `research/synthetic-allsize-identity/`; predecessor bytes and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** `synthetic-layout-independent` explicitly limits its independent evidence to finite matrices; PR2298 invokes the exact all-size algebra.
- **After:** Written universal proof plus 349,524 exact path pairs, 1,980 layouts, 13,020 chunk rounds, 450 ring-module columns across 29 shapes, and 116 explicit nonunit-two kernels. Both integral composites and base changes to Z/2,4,9,15 pass. Normalized composites pass over the two odd composite rings.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized actual CLI success/source-and-receipt rejection, six semantic controls and scoped Ruff pass. The publication committed-byte/source-history gate passes. Both direct commands pass in a Git-free export with source bytes, modes and inodes unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/synthetic-allsize-identity
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/synthetic-allsize-identity --check-source-history
```

Use an existing private external TMPDIR. Exact canonical blobs/hashes are in SOURCES.json. Baseline and submission refresh are canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Credit the pinned transform source, mightyOil's prior indexed audit/engine, the Nussbaumer–Quandalle and Harvey–van der Hoeven lineage, Douglas Colkitt, and Jose Manuel's PR2298.

The universal evidence is the informal proof, not finite extrapolation. Rounded Q_p/physical tape execution, native/ordinary/hosting refinement, full cost, outer recovery and supplier obligations remain open. Lean, Docker, full selected cold replay and hosted CI were not run locally. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
